user.title: Add apartment
user.description: Create one entry per apartment. Select a cumulative energy meter (Wh, kWh or MWh), not a power sensor. Initial readings and gaps are never billed. Maximum power bounds plausible meter increments.

installation.title: Configure SolarShare installation
installation.description: Map building sources once, then add every apartment. Devices and consumption, solar/grid/battery, self-sufficiency and daily/monthly/yearly sensors are created automatically. Use cumulative Wh/kWh/MWh counters at the same AC measurement boundary, not power sensors. Allocation is proportional per observed interval; gaps are not estimated.

data.name: Installation name
data.battery_capacity: Usable battery capacity (kWh; ignored without battery)
data.acknowledge: Sources checked: clear review hold and establish new baselines

apartments.title: Manage apartments
apartments.description: Apartments: {apartments}. Add more or edit assignments. Save applies the whole installation.

apartment.title: Apartment and meter
apartment.description: Assign the apartment's dedicated meter. All calculated points are created automatically. Editing retains its stable identity. Pausing releases the source; that load remains in the building residual. Removing does not erase stored history.

error.meter_assigned: This meter is already assigned to another active apartment. Pause that entry first.
error.recursive_meter: SolarShare output sensors cannot be used as sources.
error.not_cumulative: Choose an energy sensor with state class total or total_increasing.
error.unsupported_unit: Supported units are Wh, kWh and MWh.
error.duplicate_meter: Assign each source only once; pause the previous apartment if needed.
error.battery_pair: Select both battery charge and discharge meters, or neither.
error.missing_sources: Select PV production, grid import and grid export meters.
error.single_site: An installation already exists. Add apartments in its configuration.

abort.single_site: An installation already exists. Add apartments in its configuration.

init.title: Edit apartment and meter assignment
init.description: Totals remain with this apartment. Changing the source starts a new measurement baseline. Pause releases the meter for reassignment. Acknowledge only after checking a reset, source identity change or implausible jump; skipped energy is never recovered automatically.

data.name: Apartment name
data.paused: Pause this apartment and release its meter
data.acknowledge: I checked the source; clear the review hold and start a new baseline
